• Validity: Vehicles manufactured from July 2022 to May 2023

  • System: Electronics

  • Device: Footwell module (FLM02)

  • Fault: The welcome lights on the headlamps come on out of sync when the vehicle is opened

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Footwell module (FLM02) software error

• Action: Reprogram the footwell module (FLM02)
